literal_meaning: চিরকালের আচরণ বা প্রথা (eternal practice or custom)
figurative_meaning_bn: অতি প্রাচীনকাল থেকে চলে আসছে এমন
figurative_meaning_en: Something that has been continuing from very ancient times
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই চিরাচরিত প্রথা আমাদের সমাজে এখনও অটুট রয়েছে।
চিরাচরিত রীতি অনুসরণ করে তারা উৎসব পালন করে।
example_sentences_in_english: This time-honored tradition remains intact in our society even today.
They celebrate the festival by following age-old customs.
history: Refers to customs and practices passed down through generations in Bengali society, often linked to historical continuity without specific events.
note: This term is more of a descriptive adjective for traditions rather than a full idiomatic phrase, but used idiomatically in contexts of enduring practices.
